title: Package Marked Delivered but Customer Didn't Receive It

raw_content.initial_message: Tracking says ‘Delivered’ but there’s NOTHING here. I’ve checked everywhere. So where is my package?
raw_content.context: Shipment marked delivered but customer claims not received. Policy: apologize, verify address and delivery details, check safe drop/neighbor/front desk, open carrier investigation, set timeline for resolution, and explain replacement/refund options after investigation window.

learning_objectives: Collect the right delivery details quickly
Set clear expectations and resolution timeline
correct_sop_steps: Verify order ID and delivery address (confirm city/zip, not full address in chat if restricted)
Ask whether someone else could have received it (neighbor, concierge, reception) and check safe-drop areas
Confirm delivery timestamp and any proof-of-delivery details if available (photo/signature)
Open a carrier investigation and set the timeline for updates
Explain replacement/refund policy after investigation window and offer escalation if needed
common_mistakes: Immediately accusing the customer or the courier
Offering refund instantly without policy checks
sticky_notes: KEY: Focus on immediate actions and timeline—customer wants a plan.
TRAP: Don’t imply the customer is lying.
HINT: Provide a ‘we will update you by X time’ commitment.

bonus_points: Offers replacement as an option if urgent
Summarizes next steps clearly at the end

customer_persona_hints.secret_acceptance_condition: Will calm down if you open an investigation immediately and give a concrete update timeline
